scope: PLAN section 9 fixture preparation, authorized by KYD-139; live producer/mapping admission, retirement and cutover remain owed
entry: reader.read_jury(ctx, generation=None); explicit generation selects private candidate reads only
legacy: generation=None reads kala_convergence as stored, with no translation, mutation or candidate fallback; default writer dispatch retains legacy production behind its shim until a qualified build-safe cutover. Retirement is deferred, not claimed by fixture acceptance

candidate.binding: explicit candidate generation, ctx.config.chart_id and ctx.build_id must match kala_layer_candidate; building/complete/verified fixture candidates only; reject published head and non-fixture candidates
candidate.grain: chart_id x generation x event_class x assertion_id
candidate.dw: conditional_effect is observed incremental agreement minus conditional shift-null mean; keep signed values, zero and null, never interpret as probability, confidence or legacy convergence_score
candidate.witness_signature: stored declared admitted witness groups G-P/G-J/G-T/G-K; no statistical independence claim or count-based extra credit
candidate.output: typed JuryView with D(W), stored null qualification, witness signature, coverage and full provenance; acceptance_scope=fixture_only
candidate.identities: convergence_id, signal_id, peak_date and issuance_identity remain null with individual stage_to_reader_mapping_unadmitted reasons; assertion_id is a jury identity only
candidate.ranking: ka_tulana candidate-only ordinal sort by signed D(W) descending, unknown last, ties by event_class/assertion_id; no composite, proximity, confidence or probability conversion
candidate.persistence: read_jury is read-only; jury_reader_generation opt-in writer dispatch reports preparation only and writes no rows; there is no admitted legacy identity or issuance bridge

planning: registered Sangam plan_substeps never mutates; absent fixture inputs delegates to the read-only legacy plan and execution retains legacy production. Fixture class replacement begins only in execution inside the orchestrator transaction
deferred: conductor with k1 must admit live producers and exact stage-to-reader identity/field mappings before live integration; G-J remains subject to KYD-137 and independent complete-method admission. Legacy implementation/engine remains active behind the production shim; retirement and removal of ephemeris, prior and confidence helpers are deferred
